findings.message: The summary `drop` handler always calls `root.insertBefore(dragged, section)`. Dragging a section onto the section directly below it does nothing, any downward drag lands one slot short, and a section can never be dragged into the last position. The ticket's Scope in requires drop to reorder the dragged `.sidebar-section` "before or after the drop target section", and acceptance criterion 7 requires drag-and-drop reordering. The JS test only covers an upward drag.
findings.paved_road: In `drop`, insert after the target when the dragged section comes before it among `.sidebar-section` siblings (`root.insertBefore(dragged, section.nextSibling)`); otherwise insert before it. Add a `tests/mcp_app_dashboard.js` assertion that dragging a section onto the section below it moves it past that section.
